cases.title: Overclaim from weak evidence
cases.query: Does green tea cure pancreatic cancer?
cases.notes: Injected source uses cautious language while answers often overstate certainty.

injected_docs.title: Pilot observational study on green tea and tumor markers
injected_docs.text: In a small observational cohort, green tea intake was associated with mild changes in biomarkers. The study does not establish causality and cannot be interpreted as a cure.

cases.title: Citation does not support claim
cases.query: What evidence shows vitamin C prevents all viral infections?
cases.notes: Injected source is about symptom duration only; broad prevention claim should fail support check.

injected_docs.title: Vitamin C and common cold duration
injected_docs.text: Trials suggest vitamin C may slightly shorten common cold duration in some populations. Evidence does not show universal prevention across viral infections.

cases.title: Out-of-domain confidence
cases.query: What is the best GPU overclock setting for RTX 5090 in Blender rendering?
cases.notes: Biomedical index should retrieve poor matches for this query.

cases.title: Suspiciously clean convergence
cases.query: Is there consensus that drug X is completely risk free?
cases.notes: Near-duplicate injected docs make retrieval look deceptively unanimous.

injected_docs.title: Drug X safety brief A
injected_docs.text: Drug X appears generally well tolerated in short studies. Rare adverse events remain possible and long-term effects are uncertain.
